Mei Chen: Quick check — need to finalize the Wed RFC review agenda. We have 4 authors, 1.5h slot. Can folks confirm availability?
Samir Patel: I can take lead for the first 45m. prefer earlier (PDT). :raised_hands:
Alex Gomez: I'm +1 for earlier too. can review spike PRs in the second half.
Priya Kapoor: I'm out 11:30-12:30 PDT, otherwise good. can I do pre-read nudge?
Mei Chen: @Priya yes pls — can you send pre-reads by EOD Tues. Here's a mini template to paste into thread:
```
Agenda template:
- 0-5m: Quick intros + goals
- 5-25m: Author A (10m demo, 10m q)
- 25-45m: Author B (same)
- 45-60m: Break / overflow
- 60-80m: Author C
- 80-90m: Rapid notes + action items
```
Jamal Wright: timezone note — Author B is CET, earliest they can do is 16:00 CET (07:00 PDT). not great for west coast.
Samir Patel: hmm. can we reorder to put CET author later in the meeting? swap B and C maybe.
Alex Gomez: +1 swap, keeps author with many reviewers earlier.
Mei Chen: OK swap plan: B -> C swap. @calendar-bot can you check availability window 09:00-10:30 PDT Wed?
calendar-bot: Found conflicts: Alex (09:15-09:45 busy). Suggested 09:30-11:00 or 10:00-11:30.
Priya Kapoor: 10:00-11:30 works for me. Samir?
Samir Patel: 10:00 start works (will be 18:00 my time).
Mei Chen: Great. Priya pls send pre-reads by EOD Tue and include a 2-line TL;DR for each RFC. Also need a chair for last 20m to drive action items.
Jamal Wright: I can chair the last 20m.
Alex Gomez: I'll take notes (I'll paste in the meeting doc)
Mei Chen: Thanks all. One more ask — keep author demos to 10m max. If folks have deep design questions, mark as follow-up. Saves time.
Priya Kapoor: Sending pre-reads now. pinging authors to condense demos.
Samir Patel: :thumbsup:
Mei Chen: OK locking calendar for Wed 10:00-11:30 PDT. Thread closed unless any blockers.
